observations.behavior: Adds an optional additionalResourceDomains parameter to buildUiAppResourceMeta and spreads its contents into the resourceDomains array.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog MCP UI apps to declare extra origins for their resources without changing the base app origin. This could support loading assets from external or staging domains while keeping other apps unaffected.

observations.behavior: Defines a new resource_domains field with two S3 and localhost entries under ui_apps configuration.
observations.posthog_connection: Specifies which artifact sources are allowed for the Visual Review Snapshots custom UI app; this is used downstream by generated registration metadata.

observations.behavior: Adds tests asserting that the Visual Review artifact source appears in CSP metadata on both list and read operations.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks that the configured resource domain propagates through ResourceCatalog and does not widen unrelated app CSPs, supporting scoped asset access.

observations.limitations: The change only adds a typed option and one example entry; no broader adoption or compatibility changes are shown. The tier relies solely on these hunks.

review.limitations: The change only adds a typed option and one example entry; no broader adoption or compatibility changes are shown. The tier relies solely on these hunks.
review.reason: This is a bounded capability improvement: it introduces an optional per-app resource-domain parameter and wired-through metadata, demonstrated across config, generation, runtime, and tests. It does not show systemic risk reduction or broad architectural change.
review.posthog_relevance: Could help PostHog MCP-hosted UI apps safely load assets from designated origins while keeping other apps unaffected; relevant to reliability and security of iframe resources.
review.uncertainty: Only three hunks were examined; unreviewed parts could reveal additional dependencies or implementation gaps.
